text:
tanya: Brain dump: proposal for compact breadcrumbs + per-panel anchor routing. Goal: let users deep-link into a specific sub-panel (e.g., /.../routes?panel=traffic-insights) without exploding the left nav. Thoughts?

eric: Love the idea. Curious about how this interacts with keyboard nav and focus order. If panel opens via query param we need to move focus to the panel heading and ensure esc closes it and returns focus.

tanya: Agreed. Accessibility plan: on load if panel param present, set focus to panel heading with role=region and aria-labelledby. Also push history so back button closes panel.

marta: Routing detail: using query param makes sense for optional state, but path segments are better for external links. Could do both: canonical path /.../serving/overview/traffic-insights and legacy query param ?panel=traffic-insights as alias.

eric: Implementation concern: lots of permutations for export/import links. Will the SDK deep-link helper need to accept both?

tanya: Yes, we'll update the deep-link helper and docs. Ops: any concerns with our CDN or caching if we add many unique paths?

ops-bot: FYI: CDN caching is keyed by full path including querystring for current infra. We will need to ensure any server-side previews or signed links handle canonical paths consistently.

a11y-bot: Reminder: when panels are opened via direct URL, screen readers should get a polite announcement like: "Panel: Traffic insights, opened" and the main landmark should not be removed. Also ensure skip links navigate correctly.

marta: UX question: breadcrumbs compact variant: show "Serving / Traffic insights" but compress org/ws segments into a single pill that expands on hover. That reduces width but keeps traceability.

eric: If we compress org/ws into a pill, we need copy for truncation tooltip and keyboard-exposed expanded list. Hover-only expansions fail keyboard users.
tanya: Good catch. We'll implement a press-to-expand affordance (small chevron) that is keyboard operable and has aria-expanded. Hover can be an enhancement.

marta: Motion: panel opening should be subtle slide-up for modal-like panels, slide-left for full route transitions. Duration 160ms.
eric: History handling: prefer replaceState for the initial load (so repeated reloads don't stack) and pushState when user manually toggles panels. Back/forward should behave intuitively.

tanya: Migration: plan to maintain existing /models and /deployments routes for 90d. During that time we'll emit a console toast the first time users hit an alias: "Heads up: we've grouped Models + Deployments under Serving. Your old bookmark will still work." Option to opt-out of seeing the toast.

a11y-bot: Copy note: avoid passive voice in toasts. Maybe: "We moved Models and Deployments under Serving. Your bookmarks will keep working." Add a link "Learn more" to the migration doc.

marta: Docs checklist: breadcrumbs spec, canonical path list, query-param alias table, keyboard behaviour matrix, and a11y testing notes. I'll author the spec and ping for reviews.

eric: Dev note: need unit tests for focus restoration, integration test for back-button flows, and an E2E for deep-link share. Also add telemetry: panel-open-via-deeplink, alias-redirect-hit.

tanya: I'll create a canary branch and wire up the design tokens. Will also attach a small IA diagram mapping old -> new routes.

ops-bot: Canary preview available at https://canary.console.redwood.ai/compact-breadcrumbs (auth required).

marta: Thanks all. I'll start the spec and post mocks in this thread. If anyone has edge-cases (eg. embedded widgets / external iframes), drop them here.
